overview: Kidani Village is a Disney Vacation Club resort next to Animal Kingdom Lodge, with its own savanna and animals outside many villas.
suits: Families who love the Animal Kingdom Lodge experience and want villa space.
rooms:
As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.

Savanna-view villas cost more but have the best animal views.
pools: Samawati Springs is the main pool, with a waterslide and a splash area.
dining: Sanaa is the table-service restaurant, with savanna views. Guests can also use the restaurants at Jambo House next door.
gettingAround: Every park is reached by Disney bus.
cons: Far from Magic Kingdom and Epcot
tips: Grab breakfast at Jambo House if you want more options.
Visit the savanna overlooks early and late, when animals are most active.
bestFor: Families who want villa space with animals.
